name: furniva-loadtests
description: k6 load-test scenarios for Furniva API

scripts.test:browse:100: k6 run --out json=runs/browse-100vus.json   scenarios/01-browse-products.js --env MAX_VUS=100   --env RAMP_DURATION=30s --env STEADY_DURATION=60s
scripts.test:browse:1000: k6 run --out json=runs/browse-1000vus.json  scenarios/01-browse-products.js --env MAX_VUS=1000  --env RAMP_DURATION=60s --env STEADY_DURATION=90s
scripts.test:browse:10000: k6 run --out json=runs/browse-10000vus.json scenarios/01-browse-products.js --env MAX_VUS=10000 --env RAMP_DURATION=60s --env STEADY_DURATION=60s
scripts.test:detail:100: k6 run --out json=runs/detail-100vus.json   scenarios/02-product-detail.js  --env MAX_VUS=100   --env RAMP_DURATION=30s --env STEADY_DURATION=120s
scripts.test:detail:1000: k6 run --out json=runs/detail-1000vus.json  scenarios/02-product-detail.js  --env MAX_VUS=1000  --env RAMP_DURATION=60s --env STEADY_DURATION=120s
scripts.test:detail:10000: k6 run --out json=runs/detail-10000vus.json scenarios/02-product-detail.js  --env MAX_VUS=10000 --env RAMP_DURATION=60s --env STEADY_DURATION=60s
scripts.test:cart:100: k6 run --out json=runs/cart-100vus.json     scenarios/03-cart-flow.js       --env MAX_VUS=100   --env RAMP_DURATION=30s --env STEADY_DURATION=120s
scripts.test:cart:1000: k6 run --out json=runs/cart-1000vus.json    scenarios/03-cart-flow.js       --env MAX_VUS=1000  --env RAMP_DURATION=60s --env STEADY_DURATION=90s
scripts.test:cart:10000: k6 run --out json=runs/cart-10000vus.json   scenarios/03-cart-flow.js       --env MAX_VUS=10000 --env RAMP_DURATION=60s --env STEADY_DURATION=60s
scripts.test:all:100: npm run test:browse:100  && npm run test:detail:100  && npm run test:cart:100  && npm run test:mixed:100
scripts.test:all:1000: npm run test:browse:1000 && npm run test:detail:1000 && npm run test:cart:1000 && npm run test:mixed:1000
